reserveReview.rationale: Fresh review remains unable to assign supported reserve weights. APACX's mint guide says all existing PHT are minted with apcxUSDT backed 1:1 by USDT and its transparency page names reserve wallet TCRjE31cgksHetFLQd6JENAfBfXhHjMEFU. However, at Ethereum block 25648905 (2026-07-30T23:18:47Z), current Vat.ilks reads show positive normalized debt in five distinct branches: USDT-A, cPHP-A, ApcxUSDT-A, demoUSDT-A, and USDC-A. The issuer statement and live CDP branch graph therefore conflict, while no branch-level collateral balances or reconciliation are published. The named Tron reserve wallet held 800002.000009 USDT at the 2026-07-30T23:15:58Z Tronscan capture, which does not reconcile the multi-branch PHT collateral claims. Preserve the full residual unknown rather than forcing an unsupported allocation.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: APACX collateral disclosure cross-checked against the live Ethereum Vat/ILK branch graph and the named Tron reserve wallet; branch balances and reconciliation remain undisclosed
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The complete current PHT vault inventory, branch-level collateral balances across USDT-A/cPHP-A/ApcxUSDT-A/demoUSDT-A/USDC-A, apcxUSDT underlying reconciliation, custodian identity, and any live apcxUSDC exposure are not published as a reconciled reserve snapshot.
